[מַשֶּׁה] noun masculine loan; — only construct שָׁמוֺט כָּלֿ בַּעַל מַשֵּׁה יָדוֺ אֲשֶׁר יַשֶּׁה בְּרֵעֵהוּ Deut 15:2 every possessor of a loan of his hand shall renounce what he lends to his neighbour (compare Dr).
